notes.subject: מבחלת
notes.rationale: Hapax bilong בחל; ol tanim tok i disagree: 'hastily gotten' (KJV/JPS) o 'gotten wrongly' (YLT); mi usim 'kilim mani swift tumas'.

notes.subject: מבחלת
notes.rationale: Bilongבחל em i wanpela ples tasol long Tanakh.

notes.subject: i no ken kamap gutpela
notes.rationale: תברך em i Niphal: 'em i no gat tok gutpela long en' — pasin bilong skelim man i no tok gutpela long em.

translation: Ol samting i kamap olsem pasin bilong papa mama, sapos man i kilim mani swift tumas long stat, bihain tru bilong em i no ken kamap gutpela.

tokens.gloss: ol samting i kamap olsem pasin bilong papa mama
